title: Our Phoenix Home
description:
Welcome to our 2,900 sqft Phoenix home — a place made for comfort, laughter, and connection. In a safe, quiet neighborhood with a park out front and a private backyard, it’s perfect for family vacations, friend getaways, or work retreats. With 6 spacious bedrooms, cozy gathering areas, and easy access to all that Phoenix offers, you’ll feel right at home from the moment you arrive.

STR-2025-003605
amenities: Children’s books and toys for ages 0-2 years old, 2-5 years old, 5-10 years old, and 10+ years old
Clothing storage: walk-in closet, closet, and dresser
Coffee maker: drip coffee maker, espresso machine, pour-over coffee
Free residential garage on premises – 3 spaces
Pack ’n play/Travel crib - always at the listing
